overview: The School Committee honored numerous student award recipients in academics and robotics, heard pre-budget presentations for English Language Arts and Social Studies, and reviewed summer programming and an ELL elementary realignment plan.

items.title: Student Awards and Recognitions
items.summary: The committee presented awards to students recognized in the Scholastic Art and Writing Awards, Model United Nations, State Geography Bee, All-State Journalism, National History Day, the Holocaust Essay Contest, the Medford High School Science Fair, and the Greater New England Botball Tournament.

items.title: Approval of Minutes, Bills, and Payroll
items.summary: Approved the minutes of May 1, 2017, the biweekly payroll, and the payment of bills and transfer of funds following member questions regarding specific vendor and activity charges.

items.title: Report of the Committee of the Whole
items.summary: Approved the May 10, 2017 Committee of the Whole report as amended to record that PTO information was not presented as scheduled, following discussion about school council parent participation and immigration enforcement clarification.

items.title: Pre-Budget Report: English Language Arts
items.summary: Received and placed on file the English Language Arts pre-budget report, which highlighted the high school Ethics Bowl team's top-ten national finish and requested funding for middle school Study Island software and elementary intervention materials.

items.title: Pre-Budget Report: Social Studies
items.summary: Received and placed on file the Social Studies pre-budget report, which requested $16,000 for eleventh-grade U.S. history textbooks and course materials for a new AP Human Geography offering.

items.title: Report on Summer Programs 2017
items.summary: Received and placed on file the 2017 summer school and enrichment programming overview, featuring a transition to online secondary makeup courses through Edmentum alongside continued specialty camps.

items.title: English Language Learners Newcomers Program Redistribution
items.summary: Received and placed on file an administrative plan to redistribute the elementary English Language Learners newcomers program by relocating grades 1 and 2 from the Roberts School to the Brooks School.

items.title: Condolence Resolution and Administrative Updates
items.summary: Observed a moment of silence for Reverend Edward Doughty, and received updates regarding district graduation schedules, upcoming personnel interviews, and the initiation of the superintendent's annual performance review.
